coverage_notes: Sections 9(b), 9(d), and 9(e) contain indemnification and defense obligations, and conditions excluding those obligations. The fixed activity vocabulary has no faithful activity for providing indemnity or defense; modeling these as permissions or prohibitions on product use would misstate their legal effect.

paragraph_audit.reason: Section 9(b) requires Cohere to defend and indemnify Client against specified third-party intellectual-property Claims. Defense and indemnification are not expressible using the fixed activities; the claim-specific exceptions in the same paragraph likewise limit that remedy, not an enumerated activity.
Section 9(d) requires Client to defend and indemnify Cohere and related parties against specified Claims. Defense and indemnification are not expressible using the fixed activities.

Section 9(e)(i) requires Cohere to defend and indemnify Client and related parties against specified third-party copyright Claims concerning Client Outputs. Defense and indemnification are not expressible using the fixed activities.
Section 9(e)(ii)(A) excludes the Copyright Assurance when Client is not required to pay Fees. This limits an indemnification remedy, not an enumerated activity.
Section 9(e)(ii)(B) excludes the Copyright Assurance when Client has breached the Partner Terms or CLA. This limits an indemnification remedy, not an enumerated activity.

Section 9(e)(ii)(C) excludes the Copyright Assurance when, in Cohere’s reasonable discretion, Client intentionally uses the Cohere Products to generate potentially infringing Client Outputs. This limits an indemnification remedy, not an enumerated activity.
Section 9(e)(ii)(D) excludes the Copyright Assurance for Claims resulting from finetuning or Modifications of the Cohere Products. This limits an indemnification remedy, not an enumerated activity.
